component.name: USB Speed Tester
Analizador de velocidad USB
component.summary: Analyse, benchmark and diagnose USB storage devices
Analiza, mide y diagnostica dispositivos de almacenamiento USB

description.p: USB Speed Tester is a desktop application that runs the usual Linux USB diagnostic tools for you and explains the results in plain language.

ul.li: the negotiated link speed of the bus (5000M for USB 3.x, 480M for USB 2.0);
cached and physical read speed with hdparm;
sequential and 4K random throughput and IOPS with fio;
SMART health information when the USB bridge supports it.

description.p: An illustrated tutorial explains how to recognise a real SuperSpeed port by the SS marking next to the connector, and the interface is available in English and Spanish.

screenshot.caption: Analysing a USB flash drive and reading the results
